title: Kosher Manti with Semi-Skimmed Milk Sauce
description: A delicious and velvety Turkish dish featuring semi-skimmed milk sauce served over kosher manti dumplings for a quick and satisfying weeknight meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Semi-Skimmed Milk and all-purpose flour. Add cold water and stir until smooth.
Add salt to taste and mix well. Transfer dough onto a floured surface and knead for about 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 balls. Roll each ball out into a thin circle, approximately 3 inches in diameter.
Place a small spoonful of the semi-skimmed milk sauce on one side of a manti wrapper. Fold the wrapper over and pinch the edges together to seal.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Place manti dumplings in the heated oil, ensuring they do not stick to the pan. Fry until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve with semi-skimmed milk sauce poured over each dumpling.

For Semi-Skimmed Milk Sauce: In a blender or food processor, blend 1 cup of Semi-Skimmed Milk and 1/4 cup of all-purpose flour until smooth. Strain the mixture to remove any lumps and pour it back into the pan. Bring to a simmer and cook for about 2-3 minutes until thickened. Adjust seasoning with salt if needed.
